Production entry module ladon.source_goal_capture. Dataclass SourceGoalCaptureRequest(repo_root:Path,source_path:str,module:str,line:int,column:int,toolchain:LeanToolchainContext,goal_ordinal:int|None=None,expected_source_digest:str|None=None,timeout_seconds:float=60,max_output_bytes:int=8MiB,max_rss_bytes:int=32GiB,require_isolation:bool=False). repo-relative regular source, line1-based, column0-based Lean Unicode character column, ordinal0-based. Toolchain selection explicit. Source/helper/compiled dependency inputs bounded and verified; no production writes/builds, all source snapshots in owned temporary dirs. Trusted target execution policy and standard supervisor reused.
API capture_source_goal(request, *, runner=run_bounded_target_process, helper_path=None) -> dict. New closed helper protocol ladon-lean-source-goal-v1/capture, existing semantic-v3 unchanged. Result schema ladon-source-goal-capture-result-v1, operation capture-source-goal, status one of captured, ambiguous, unavailable, stale, timeout, memory-limit, output-limit, process-failed. All noncaptured results capture=None and diagnostic {code,message,...}. Every result resourceAccounting elapsedSeconds,peakRssBytes plus observed process receipts. No accepted/completed/truth label. Preflight request shape errors may raise ValueError; ambient context returns unavailable; expected-source mismatch returns stale before running.
A captured result capture object binds source {path,module,digest,byteLength,position:{line,column,byteOffset},syntaxRange:{startByte,endByte}}, environment {executionContextRef,leanVersion,leanCommit,executableDigest,compiledInventory,namespace,openDeclarationsStructural,optionsStructural}, goal {goalId,ordinal,goalCount,typeDisplay,typeStructural,localContext}. captureId a digest over complete bound capture except itself. Each observed local row {localId,userName,binderInfo,typeDisplay,typeStructural,valueDisplay,valueStructural,dependencies,implementationDetail}; preserve exact raw fvar identifiers and order, values/dependencies including local let value dependencies, not reconstructed name matching. Keep internal locals explicitly flagged, never turn them into new assumed user premises. Scope/environment values come from selected InfoTree ContextInfo. Multiple live goals at same source location require ordinal; no implicit first selection. Out-of-range and unavailable info return explicit failures, not handwritten substitute. Source changes before/after invalidate; mismatched frame context/position/module/request invalidate; duplicate frames invalid. Source original unchanged; unfinished file diagnostics not automatically fatal if the selected supported goal is present, but no admitted proof claim.
Environment binding before/after: initial observation discovers selected import closure; hash exact compiled inventory incl olean, .server/.private/.ir/.ir.sig with existing byte bounds; second bound observation must match closure and source/context position; rehash inventory/toolchain/source afterward; only second observation published. Inventory snapshots bound to selected goal env, no mere toolchain filename or final commandstate substitution. Source snapshot bytes identical to bound source, originalfilename supplied to frontend without instrumentation or altered positions. Failure or unsupported semantic case explicit. No external dependency, no global installs/sharedbuilds; helper resource packaged with existing mechanism. Accepted profile initially ordinary nonmodular source setup (no plugins/dynlibs/custom setup), record unsupported modular/new toolchain features if needed.
Acceptance: meaningful red tests, real dependent α,x,h plus let y value x/notation, two selectable goals and ambiguous control, unfinished proof, exact byte/range and local IDs, Unicode position, stale expected source, internal-local flag, environment identity/inventory, no original edits; injected mismatches and process limits fail without capture. Bounded real Lean budget cumulative180s including prior~9.3s prototype, <=60 per invocation,32GiB actualRSS tracked. Distinct red, green and audit roles, all Luna medium; root owns integration/frozen tests/task checkoffs. No new completion, binder-premise or comparative usefulness credit.
